config.loss: mean per-position KL(target || drafter), full vocabulary, temperature 1
config.positions: all 256 prefixes per chunk; no padding, labels, chat template, or activation matching
config.checkpoint_selection: lowest KL on all 50 validation chunks, including phase-start weights
config.timing: synchronized wall time including prefill and all decode work; both drafters merged/plain

dataset_manifest.sampling: one random 256-token window per article, same seeded shuffled source order as pilot
limitations: Exact passage checks cover the fixed evaluation windows, not semantic paraphrases.
Official evaluation articles are excluded by normalized title and whole-article hash.
Article-balanced Wikipedia sampling does not establish topic balance or code/chat performance.
No training or final-test evaluation is performed by this CPU preparation step.
